summary: Verified fix for browser-auto-translate induced React NotFoundError/removeChild crash on /dashboard. Served HTML confirmed with lang='tr', translate='no', class='notranslate' on <html> and <meta name='google' content='notranslate'>. Simulated English-locale browser (Accept-Language: en-US) — logged in as cemil63@gmail.com, loaded /dashboard, verified KPIs and Recharts (18 SVG chart elements) render, navigated all sidebar routes (/cari, /bahceler, /gunluk-takip, /stok, /raporlar, /dashboard). Zero pageerrors. Zero occurrences of 'removeChild', 'NotFoundError' or 'not a child' across all routes. Bug fix VERIFIED.

issues: Recharts emits repeated warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — ResponsiveContainer likely rendering before parent has computed layout. Non-crashing, but noisy console. Consider adding minWidth/minHeight or delaying render until container mounts.

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts width/height(-1) warnings by giving ResponsiveContainer explicit minHeight or gating chart render on data length (cosmetic only, not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correctly applied and served: lang='tr', translate='no', notranslate class, and google notranslate meta are all present in the deployed HTML head.
Consider also adding translate='no' on the root <div id='root'> or key React containers as belt-and-suspenders, since some translation extensions ignore <meta>/lang hints.
seed_data_creation: None — leveraged existing empty/UITEST data from iteration_1; no new records required to reproduce or verify the crash fix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_2 focused solely on verifying the /dashboard removeChild/NotFoundError fix via notranslate attributes. Verified in a browser sending Accept-Language: en-US to emulate the original crash trigger. Only console noise is Recharts width/height(-1) warnings (cosmetic, not related to the crash) and two 401s on initial anonymous /api/auth/me probes (expected).
rca of the issue: RCA: When the preview app was rendered in an English-locale Chrome, the built-in Google Translate feature auto-translated the Turkish UI. Translation wraps text nodes in <font> elements and moves them, mutating the DOM out from under React's reconciler. During unmount, React's commitDeletionEffectsOnFiber called removeChild on a node whose real parent had been changed by the translator, throwing DOMException NotFoundError. Mitigation: set lang='tr', translate='no', class='notranslate' on <html> and add <meta name='google' content='notranslate'> to instruct Chrome/Google Translate not to translate this document. Verified served HTML contains all four signals; dashboard now renders crash-free under en-US Accept-Language.
